messages:
anya: Announcement: were opening a gated preview for a new Dedicated tier — L5e-mini — in Istanbul (IST) and Helsinki (HEL) next Thursday at 09:00 local. Target customers: latency-sensitive edge apps. Capacity limited; pilots only.

matt: Heads-up on policy: this rollout introduces the new "flex-reserve" mode. Flex-reserve lets customers convert up to 30% of a reserved commit into burstable capacity that can be used by other tenants when idle. It reduces wasted reserved hours but changes billing semantics slightly.

anya: TL;DR on billing: flex -> reserved portion billed at standard reserved rate; converted burst minutes billed at preemptible rate to the converting account if used. Well emit a new invoice tag: "flex_converted". Finance will publish examples in the billing docs.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/l5e-mini-flex-reserve-preview (internal) :link: 

ops: Ops notes: flex-reserve has a 2-hour retraction window: once converted, tenants have 2h to reclaim before capacity rebalances. Theres also a new auto-scale policy for Dedicated pools: "scale_on_util" that can add short-lived nodes when pool utilization > 85% for 5m. Auto-scale nodes are preemptible.

matt: Console/CLI: added toggles in Dedicated > Pools > L5e-mini to enable flex-reserve and scale_on_util. CLI example: 
```
redwood pools update --pool l5e-mini-ist --flex-reserve 30 --enable-scale-on-util 85 300
```

anya: Private customers: note driver/runtime reqs in runbook. Private control planes must opt-in to flex-feature-flag v1.4 prior to routing. If youre managing Private deployments, schedule upgrades before launch.

finance: Billing examples will be posted in the runbook and Console Cost panel will show flex_converted, preemptible_reclaim, and reserved_charge line items. Preview discounted at 65% of GA reserved list; no SLA during preview.

ops: Migration guidance: start small canaries, keep KV cache warm during reclaim windows, and prefer short reservation intervals if you intend to use flex-reserve heavily. Well auto-fallback to L5e-standard when L5e-mini capacity exhausted.

anya: Pilot nominations: PMs/SEs, DM me tenant ids for pilot access. Ops will schedule weekday daytime slots + one nightly buffer per region. Metrics dashboards added under Dedicated > Pools > L5e-mini. :white_check_mark:
